page.overview:
What is The Memory Remains?

The Memory Remains is the second track on the album, ReLoad. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich,

It is about a forgotten celebrity who is always reliving her glory days and falling from reality in the process.

"The Memory Remains" is one of 2 songs from ReLoad (The other being "Fuel") featured in the multi-platform game Guitar Hero: Metallica. It was considered to be an "Intermediate level song" while performing guitar, because it was encountered early in the game's career mode.

Fortune, fame Mirror vain Gone insane But the memory remains
